title: About FXN Holdings | Digital Venture Group
description: FXN Holdings is a digital venture group that explores opportunities, then builds and launches websites across regions on open-source technology.
heading: Always exploring. Always building. Always launching.
intro: FXN Holdings is a digital venture group. We look for gaps worth filling, then build and launch the websites and platforms to fill them: online stores, travel booking, price comparison, editorial publishing and free online tools. Each one is built on modern, open-source technology to keep it lean and profitable, and each one is set up for the market it serves and the rules that apply there.
sections: "Find the opportunity, build it well, launch it where it fits, and make it pay."

Our Story

Started with one site. Built into a portfolio.

FXN Holdings began as a single project and grew the way most good ideas do: one launch taught us how to make the next one faster, cheaper and better. Today the group runs a portfolio of platforms across e-commerce, travel, comparison, publishing and online tools. Each platform was started because we saw a real gap in a real market.

We are not tied to one product, one platform or one country. When a new opportunity appears, whether it's a growing search trend, a new partner program, a supplier looking for reach or a region that's poorly served, we look at it, test it and, if the numbers stack up, build it.

The Operating Model

Explore. Build. Launch. Grow.

Explore

We research markets, search demand, competitors and partner programs to find opportunities with real potential. Ideas get tested quickly and cheaply before they get serious investment.

Build

We build on the latest frameworks and proven open-source software, using our own reusable templates. That keeps build costs low, avoids vendor lock-in, and gets a platform from idea to live in weeks rather than months.

Launch

Every project launches for a specific region, with its legal pages, privacy controls, tax set-up and payment options matched to that market before the first visitor arrives.

Grow

After launch we measure everything: traffic, conversion, revenue per visitor. We improve what works, fix or drop what doesn't, and reinvest the gains so each platform reaches its targets.

What We Believe

Useful first. Profitable because of it.

  • Visitors come first.

    A platform only lasts if people find it genuinely useful, so we build tools, comparisons and content that solve a real problem.

  • Open source is an advantage.

    Mature open-source software gives us enterprise-grade foundations without enterprise-grade costs, and those savings go into the product.

  • Every market is different.

    Rules, languages, currencies and customer expectations change from one region to the next, so we build for each market rather than copying and pasting.

  • Numbers decide.

    Every project has clear targets. We keep the ones that hit them and learn from the ones that don't.

Local by Design

Different regions. Different rules. Every project built to meet them.

The group operates through entities suited to the regions we trade in. Before any platform goes live, it is set up for the privacy, consumer, advertising and tax requirements of the market it serves.

DATA

Privacy & data protection

Consent, cookies and personal data are handled to the law of each platform's market: GDPR and UK GDPR in Europe and the UK, and the local equivalent everywhere else.

ADS

Advertising & consumer law

Affiliate links and sponsored placements are clearly disclosed, and pricing, returns and consumer rights follow the rules of the country the customer buys in.

TAX

Local entity & tax

Each project trades through the group entity suited to its region, with VAT and sales tax registered and charged where the law requires it.

title: Accessibility Statement | FXN Holdings
description: How FXN Holdings makes fxnholdings.com usable for everyone: our WCAG 2.2 AA target, what we have done, known limitations and how to report a problem.
heading: Accessibility Statement
intro: We want everyone to be able to use this website, whatever their device, ability or assistive technology.
sections:
Last updated: 23 October 2026

On this page

  1. 1. Our commitment
  2. 2. What we have done
  3. 3. Known limitations
  4. 4. Feedback and help
  5. 5. Review of this statement

1. Our commitment

We aim for this website to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA. Accessibility is part of how we design and build the site, not an afterthought.

2. What we have done

  • We design text and interface colours for readable contrast.
  • Navigation includes keyboard controls, visible focus and a "Skip to content" link.
  • Pages use a clear heading structure, one main heading per page, and descriptive link text.
  • Icons are decorative and hidden from screen readers; controls without visible text have accessible labels.
  • Layouts adapt to phones, tablets and desktops.
  • Animations respect your device's "reduce motion" setting.
  • Form fields have labels and use browser validation.

3. Known limitations

Some third-party websites we link to, including our managed platforms, are run separately and may not meet the same standard. We have not completed an independent accessibility audit and do not claim certified WCAG conformance. Email us if a diagram, animation or form creates a barrier; we can explain information in text.

4. Feedback and help

If you have trouble using any part of this website, or need information in another format, email contact@fxnholdings.com with "Accessibility" in the subject line. Tell us the page and the problem, and we will get back to you.

5. Review of this statement

We review this statement when we make significant changes to the website. The date above shows the latest revision.

description: How fxnholdings.com uses cookies: only strictly necessary storage, no analytics or advertising trackers, and how to manage cookies in your browser.
heading: Cookie Policy
intro: How this website uses cookies and similar local-storage technologies.
sections:
Last updated: 23 October 2026

On this page

  1. 1. What cookies are
  2. 2. The cookies we use
  3. 3. Managing cookies
  4. 4. Changes to this Cookie Policy
  5. 5. Contact

1. What cookies are

Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. Similar technologies include local storage and pixels.

2. Storage used by this website

This version of the website does not set application cookies, use local or session storage, or load analytics, advertising pixels or a chat assistant. Animation pause controls and interface state are held in page memory and reset when the page is reloaded.

Hosting and security infrastructure may process connection information. Browser caching of website files is separate from advertising tracking. External websites, including the linked live contact form and listed platforms, have their own storage practices.

Where UK rules require consent for storage or access technologies, we will obtain it before activation and provide a way to withdraw it. Any applicable exception must meet its legal conditions. We will update this policy if the site’s technology changes. Personal information is covered by our Privacy Policy.

3. Managing cookies

Most browsers let you view, manage, delete and block cookies. Blocking storage on external services may affect their features. Guidance is available at www.aboutcookies.org or in your browser’s help section.

4. Changes to this Cookie Policy

If our use of cookies changes, we will update this page and, where required by law, ask for your consent.

5. Contact

Questions about cookies: contact@fxnholdings.com. See also our Privacy Policy.

1. Who we are

This website, fxnholdings.com (the “Website”), is operated by FXN Holdings (“we”, “us”, “our”), an Australian business (ABN 53 274 423 748).

Postal address: PO Box 500, WEST PERTH WA 6872. Contact email: contact@fxnholdings.com.

FXN Holdings is responsible for the personal information collected through the Website under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth).

2. The personal data we collect

This is an informational corporate website. It does not sell products or services, require an account, or use analytics or advertising tracking. We keep data collection to a minimum.

  • Information you give us: when you contact us by email or through a form, we receive your name, email address, company (if provided) and the contents of your message.
  • Technical data collected automatically: our hosting provider and web server may log limited technical information such as IP address, browser type, device information, referring page, and the date and time of your visit.
  • Cookies and storage: this version does not set application cookies or use browser storage for tracking — see our Cookie Policy.

The contact form prepares a draft in your email application. We receive its contents only if you send the email. The linked live contact form is a separate service. This version of the website does not provide a chat assistant.

3. Why we use your information

Where UK GDPR applies, responding to general business enquiries and securing this website are based on legitimate interests in communicating with interested visitors and protecting the service, subject to your rights. Steps you request before a contract may instead rely on contractual necessity. Required legal records rely on legal obligations. Any activity requiring consent must obtain it separately; browsing this website is not consent to marketing.

We collect and use personal information only for the purposes below, or for related purposes you would reasonably expect. We do not use automated decision-making or profiling, and we do not knowingly collect sensitive information.

Purpose Why we need it
Responding to your enquiries and correspondence To reply to you and deal with what you have asked for
Operating, maintaining and securing the Website To keep the Website running and secure
Complying with legal obligations Where an applicable law requires it

4. How we share your data

We do not sell your personal data and do not share it for advertising purposes. We may disclose data to:

  • service providers who help us run the Website (such as our hosting and email providers);
  • professional advisers (such as lawyers or accountants) where necessary;
  • public authorities or regulators where required by law.

5. Overseas disclosure

UK and Australian operations may involve cross-border handling. Where UK GDPR restricts a transfer, an applicable adequacy regulation, appropriate safeguards such as approved contractual terms, or a permitted exception is required. Shared ownership alone is not a transfer safeguard. Contact us to request information about safeguards applicable to your information.

Some of our service providers (such as our hosting and email providers) may store or process personal information outside Australia. Where we disclose personal information overseas, we take reasonable steps to ensure it is handled consistently with the Australian Privacy Principles.

6. How long we keep your data

Retention depends on whether the enquiry remains active, whether a business relationship follows, applicable record-keeping duties and the need to resolve disputes. Ask us about the criteria for your particular correspondence.

We may keep certain information longer where required to comply with a legal obligation or to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

  • Enquiry and correspondence data: kept only as long as needed to handle your enquiry and a reasonable period afterwards, then deleted.
  • Server-log data: kept for a short period for security and diagnostics, then deleted or anonymised.

7. Your rights

Where UK GDPR applies, you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability, and may object to processing based on legitimate interests. These rights depend on the circumstances and lawful basis. You can withdraw consent at any time where processing relies on consent, without affecting earlier lawful processing. You may object to direct marketing at any time. We do not make solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects through this website.

Under the Australian Privacy Principles you can ask to access the personal information we hold about you and ask us to correct it. You can also ask us to delete it or to stop contacting you.

To exercise any of these rights, email us at contact@fxnholdings.com. For Australian access and correction requests, we aim to respond within 30 days. UK GDPR requests are normally answered within one month; where a lawful extension applies, we will explain it within the initial response period. We may need proportionate information to verify your identity.

8. Complaints

If you believe we have not handled your data properly, please contact us first. If you are not satisfied with our response, you can lodge a complaint with:

  • Australia: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC), GPO Box 5288, Sydney NSW 2001 — oaic.gov.au
  • United Kingdom: you can complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO). You do not have to complete our internal complaints process before contacting the ICO.

9. Visitors from outside Australia

  • European Economic Area: additional rights may apply where processing falls within the EU GDPR.
  • Other jurisdictions may provide additional rights where their laws apply. Contact us with a request concerning your information.
  • United Kingdom: we process UK visitors’ data consistently with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.
  • Other countries: we comply with applicable data-protection laws where we operate.

10. Children

The Website is not directed at children and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

11. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date above shows the latest revision; material changes will be posted on this page.

12. Contact

Questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data: FXN Holdings — contact@fxnholdings.com — ABN 53 274 423 748, PO Box 500, WEST PERTH WA 6872.

title: Capabilities: Research, Build & Launch | FXN Holdings

intro: FXN Holdings takes an opportunity from first research to a live, earning platform. We choose the right technology for the job, build on open-source foundations, and launch each project for the region and audience it's meant to serve.
sections:
Opportunity research

Before we build anything, we work out whether it's worth building. We look at search demand, competition, partner programs and margins to find the markets where a new platform can win.

  • Keyword, search and market demand research
  • Competitor and gap analysis by region
  • Partner, supplier and affiliate program review
  • Quick, low-cost tests before full build

Platform build & launch

We design and build on current frameworks and proven open-source software, using our own reusable templates, so each new platform launches faster and costs less to run.

  • Modern front ends with Next.js, React and Tailwind CSS
  • Headless content and product data with Strapi
  • Commerce on Shopify and WooCommerce with supplier integrations
  • Workflow automation with n8n; containerised hosting on Docker, Hetzner and Vercel

Local setup & compliance

Every launch is set up for its market. Legal pages, consent, disclosures, tax and payments are matched to the region before the platform goes live.

  • Privacy and cookie consent to local law (GDPR, UK GDPR and equivalents)
  • Clear affiliate and advertising disclosures
  • VAT and sales-tax set-up through the right group entity
  • Local currency, language and payment options where they matter

Growth & monetisation

Once a platform is live, we grow it with search, content and data, and earn from it in ways that don't get in the visitor's way.

  • SEO, structured data and AI-search readiness
  • Affiliate, advertising and direct product revenue
  • Analytics-led testing and conversion improvements
  • Shared learnings and infrastructure across the portfolio

title: Technology & AI | Open-Source Platform | FXN Holdings
description: How FXN Holdings builds: a shared open-source platform, the technology behind each website, and our position on AI built with regulation and human review.
heading: The platform behind our websites
intro: We run and maintain our own technology. Shared services sit behind most of our websites, and AI helps us work faster, with a person checking everything before it is published.
sections:
One shared platform

Instead of a separate back end for every website, our content and comparison sites draw on shared services. A fix or an improvement made once reaches all of them.

  1. 01 · Sources

    Retailer and partner data feeds bring in offers, prices, specifications and product images

  2. 02 · Content platform

    One headless CMS stores content for our content and comparison sites, each in its own space

  3. 03 · Websites

    Each website is built and deployed on its own, so a change to one can't take down another

  4. 04 · Readers

    Our Next.js sites render pages on the server, so they load quickly and are easy for search engines to read

Headless content platform

A single CMS holds articles, products, offers and pages for our content and comparison sites, and delivers them to each one through an API.

Data and enrichment

Automated jobs collect offers, prices and product details from retailer and partner feeds, then organise them into the catalogue.

Product search

A shared search service indexes the products in our catalogue so they can be found quickly.

Platforms by website

Different websites need different tools. Content and comparison sites run on Next.js with a headless CMS; our online stores run on hosted store platforms or WooCommerce.

How we build

Engineering habits we apply across our websites.

Independent deployments

Each website builds and releases on its own, so an update to one site never interrupts another.

Server-rendered pages

Our Next.js sites send pages ready to read, which keeps them fast on phones and clear for search engines.

Built-in fallbacks

If the content platform is briefly unavailable, our CMS-backed sites fall back to stored content instead of showing an error.

Secure by default

Every site is served over HTTPS, and secrets stay out of our code repositories.

We believe in AI, built with regulation

AI is changing how information is found, written and published. We think it will make useful websites better: faster to update, more complete and easier to use.

We also think that only works if AI is developed and used within clear rules. People should be able to trust what they read, know who is responsible for it, and have their privacy respected. We welcome regulation that makes that the norm, in Australia and in the markets our readers come from, and we will follow it as it develops.

How we use AI today

We use AI to draft and enrich content, such as product titles and descriptions, so our catalogue stays complete and consistent.

Our commitment

A person reviews AI-assisted content before anything is published.

AI draft→Human review→Published

AI speeds up our work. It does not decide what goes live on our websites; our team does.

Questions about our technology?

We're happy to talk about how we build and run our websites.
